darren (People Ops): @mia quick one — you said you need to add your daughter Ava as a dependent because she lost employer coverage on 2026-06-30. We can do a QLE for loss of other coverage if you upload proof within 30 days. What docs do you have?
mia chen: Hey thanks. I have her employer termination letter dated 2026-06-30 and her COBRA offer. She's 24 and in grad school, living with me now. Do carriers care about student status at her age?
darren (People Ops): Most carriers cover dependents up to 26 regardless of student status, so age 24 is fine. For the QLE we need proof of loss of coverage (termination or COBRA notice) showing the event date, and proof of relationship (birth certificate) if she wasn't previously on your plan. Since she's moving in, a utility bill or lease showing shared address within 30 days helps but isn't always required.
mia chen: I don't have a recent joint lease but I do have a utility joint bill and her school enrollment letter. Also, will adding her affect my HSA contributions? I'm on HDHP+HSA.
samir khan: Payroll note: Adding a dependent doesn't change HSA eligibility by itself. HSA eligibility depends on the plan you elect; if you stay on HDHP you can keep contributing. If you switch plans, that affects contributions. If the carrier makes the enrollment retroactive to 6/30 and we need to adjust premiums, we'll do a payroll reconciliation for deductions.
benefits-bot: @mia Upload steps: Benefits -> Report Life Event -> Loss of Other Coverage -> Add Dependent. Required docs: 1) Employer termination or COBRA letter (required). 2) Proof of relationship if not on file (birth certificate). Optional: proof of residence (utility, lease), student enrollment letter. Accepted formats: PDF/JPG/PNG. Max 10MB. Recommended filenames: chen_ava_cobra_20260630.pdf, chen_ava_birthcert.pdf
mia chen: Uploaded chen_ava_cobra_20260630.pdf and chen_ava_birthcert.pdf. I also attached a screenshot of her lease move-in email. Sent SSN via secure form since the COBRA letter has it.
hr-portal-bot: Documents received. Case ID QLE-2026-1437 opened. Verification ETA 2 business days. If carrier requires additional proof we'll post in this thread.
darren (People Ops): Great, @mia. If verification completes within 30 days the carrier will often set the effective date to the loss-of-coverage date (6/30) and payroll will issue any retro premium adjustments. If verification is late, effective date may be the approval date.
mia chen: If they approve retro to 6/30 and I get a refund for premium, will that show as a separate refund or as a negative premium on my paycheck?
samir khan: Usually it posts as a correction line on the next paycheck; sometimes payroll issues a separate refund depending on timing. We'll notify you with the exact payroll posting once reconciliation runs. Also save the COBRA termination doc for your records.
darren (People Ops): If you want, I can DM you a short checklist for the carrier (relationship proof, termination/COBRA, SSN secure submit). Otherwise we'll update here when verification completes. :thumbsup:
